title: INDIAN NAVY’S EASTERN FLEET SHIPS UDAYGIRI, KAVARATTI, AND SHAKTI ARRIVE AT SATTAHIP, THAILAND
text:
Press Release Page | Press Information Bureau

Ministry of Defence

INDIAN NAVY’S EASTERN FLEET SHIPS UDAYGIRI, KAVARATTI, AND SHAKTI ARRIVE AT SATTAHIP, THAILAND

प्रविष्टि तिथि:
27 JUN 2026 1:40PM by PIB Delhi

Indian Naval Ships Udaygiri, Kavaratti, and Shakti of the Eastern Fleet arrived at Sattahip, Thailand,
as part of their operational deployment to the South East Asia Region.

The ships, led by RAdm Alok Ananda, Flag Officer Commanding Eastern Fleet, were received by the Royal Thai Navy. The port call is part of India's continued maritime engagement with South East Asian nations and reflects the close and long-standing maritime partnership between India and Thailand.

The visit will include professional exchanges, cross-deck visits, operational interactions, sporting engagements, and community outreach aimed at strengthening navy-to-navy cooperation and interoperability.

The port call aims to further strengthen camaraderie, mutual cooperation, and bilateral maritime ties between India and Thailand. It also showcases the
indigenous design, modular construction, and state-of-the-art technology of Indian Naval ships,
 highlighting India's growing capabilities, and credentials as a reliable partner, in defence technology.
